title: ScreenplayConcept
description: Phase 01 premise and synopsis. Tier 1 pure markdown. slot/status are managed by dl artifact itself and are not written into content JSON. Content fields: target_language (for downstream phase inheritance) + concept (markdown body with Logline / four dimensions / Core Drama / Synopsis).

target_language.description: Target language used for user-visible artifacts and the final screenplay. Downstream phases inherit this value.

concept.description: Complete premise document markdown: Logline (reveals ending) + four dimensions (tone / satisfaction / protagonist background / core expectation) + Core Drama (goal + conflict) + setup-development-turn-resolution synopsis (200-500 word Archplot passage).
